composition_subtypes.role: Sort distinct letters from original string in increasing order.
Iteratively assign largest remaining letter to positions with zero b[i].

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort letters from s; then greedily assign letters to zeros of b, updating remaining b values.
payload.rationale: The solution combines sorting to order available letters with a greedy iterative assignment algorithm that processes positions in order of b values, making it a composition of sorting and greedy.
